title: Qualia Under the Snow
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Akio, a university student in a snowy town who prefers plants to people, lives in the same dorm as Umi, an outgoing younger student whose relationships with men never go past one-night stands. As Umi warms to him, Akio slowly opens up, and the two begin to face their pasts and Umi's longing to be loved back. A single-volume boys' love slice-of-life story.
life_message: Patient, non-transactional care can help a lonely person believe they are worth loving.
